text:
ari: Quick sync — finalizing the new-user welcome arc. Aim: low-friction onboarding + webinar invite for engaged users.

sam: Outline: 3 emails over 10 days. Day 0: welcome + quickstart. Day 3: product tips + CTA. Day 4: webinar invite (conditional on click/open). Day 10: nudge.

priya: Deliverability check: IP warm-up still ongoing. Recommend starting at 2k/day, ramp 2x every 48h. Also confirm suppression lists and seed addresses.

maya: Email templates are mobile-first, 600px width. Designed variants for promo vs transactional layouts. Will attach Figma link in thread.

zach: Subject line candidates (short A/B):
- "Welcome to Redwood — get up and running"
- "Quick wins: 5 minutes to integrate inference"
- "Join our live demo: make inference predictable"

ari: For behavioral branching: if user opens or clicks within 72h -> send webinar invite on day 4; if no engagement -> send a troubleshooting checklist on day 5. Need Liquid conditions in template.

sam: Proposed segmentation rules:
- Segment: "Fresh signups" = created <72h
- Segment: "Active trial" = api_calls > 10 in first 3 days
- Segment: "No activity" = created >48h and api_calls == 0

ari: QA checklist before rollout:
1) Send tests to seed list (deliverability + inbox previews)
2) Check personalization tokens (company, plan) + fallbacks
3) Validate UTM tags and tracking pixels
4) Confirm suppression and unsubscribe links
5) Run subject line small A/B (1% each) for open signal

priya: Also validate header DKIM/SPF/DMARC and Return-Path. I'll run a preflight report Friday.

maya: Reminder: include alt text for hero images and accessible CTA labels.

zach: Small copy tweak: emphasize "predictable inference" in email 2. Keep CTA to one primary action.

ari: Test plan:
- Seed list (dev + deliverability) = 200 emails
- 1% of daily new signups as pilot for two days
- Monitor opens, clicks, bounces in real-time in dashboard

sam: Rollout timing suggestion: stagger APAC sends to local morning windows. Use send windows: 9am local.

ari: Action items:
- @maya share final Figma (due Thu)
- @zach lock subject lines and preheader by Thu EOD
- @priya run preflight and confirm ramping plan
- @sam set up segment definitions and test seeds

deploy-bot: send-schedule created: 2026-04-01T09:00:00-07:00 (PST) for pilot cohort. ID: send_98312

priya: Noted, I'll pause ramp if bounce rate >1.2% in pilot.

ari: Thanks everyone — aim to reconvene Fri 10am to review seed metrics. :rocket:
